beats.say: One image requires fifty two million pixel updates behind the scenes.
A single square image spans one thousand twenty four pixels across.
Multiplying width by height gives over one million pixels on screen.
Generating the image takes fifty discrete steps.
In step one, all one million pixels update once.
In step two, all one million pixels update again.
The math repeats fifty times until the picture clears up.
Fifty passes multiplied by one million pixels equals fifty two million updates.
You only see one finished frame at the end.
The machine threw away fifty one million intermediate calculations.
Simple pictures hide millions of tiny loops in the background.
One image is fifty two million pixel updates.
